title: Core transported selected extension data on the actual étale sequence site
statement:
For every scheme W, coefficient tower B, and order embedding r, the actual étale sequence site admits the transported core selected-extension data before level normalization. Precisely:
```lean
theorem etaleCofinalExtension_core_nonempty (W : Scheme.{u}) {l : ℕ}
    (B : Coefficients.{u} l) (r : ℕ ↪o ℕ) :
    Nonempty (CofinalExtensionCore W B r)
```
